visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair, wearing a wide-brimmed straw hat with a black ribbon and a grey t-shirt, stands outdoors under a bright blue sky. She smiles and speaks directly into her handheld camera for a selfie shot. Behind her, a concrete path runs alongside the ocean where rocky shores and distant mountains are visible under natural sunlight. (2) The scene transitions to a large red and grey promotional display for Heping Island Geopark, followed by a wide shot of a sandy beach with white shade canopies. The background features rugged rock formations and calm turquoise water under clear weather. (3) Several shots show children in swimsuits and life jackets walking toward a shallow, calm natural pool. A boy adjusts a green and yellow snorkeling mask and dives into the water. Underwater footage reveals many small silver fish swimming over rocky and mossy surfaces. (4) The camera shows three lifeguards in red shirts sitting under a white tent near the water. A close-up reveals a small crab moving on sun-bleached rocks. The scene shifts indoors to a clean restroom with stainless steel sinks and coin-operated hair dryers. A close-up shot of a freezer shows various 'Honey Agar-Agar' ice pops. (5) On a sunny paved square, a young boy in a grey shirt and a girl in a blue shirt are interviewed. The boy uses animated facial expressions and hand gestures to describe finding sea anemones. The girl crouches to put on her white sandals as they talk to the off-camera woman.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 周末發現帶小孩練浮潛的寶藏景點. [Logo]: 基隆和平島地質公園. (2) [Slogan]: 獨家優惠. (3) [Subtitle]: 除了有一望無際的沙灘... 還有適合小孩的天然海水生態池... (4) [Subtitle]: 高度約60公分... Baby會走路就可以輕易站立... 適合來幫小小小孩練水性... (5) [Subtitle]: 大一點的孩子可在2.5公尺水深的... [Logo]: 藍海水池. [Subtitle]: 藍海水池浮潛... (6) [Subtitle]: 可以看到很多海水魚喔... 還有專業的救生員隨時緊盯... 岸邊有螃蟹隨時會跑出來... (7) [Subtitle]: 浮潛 看魚 找螃蟹... 就可以待一個上午或下午啦... (8) [Subtitle]: 廁所很乾淨 換洗很方便... (9) [Subtitle]: 遊客中心還有賣基隆特產... [Logo]: 石花凍冰棒. [Subtitle]: 石花凍冰棒... (10) [Subtitle]: 問小孩好不好玩 他們說... 好玩啊... 重點是有那個... 有什麼? [Variety]: 海葵! [Subtitle]: 我還用腳去摸它... 好玩嗎 姐姐... 好玩 下次還要來~
